_comment: This is the configuration file for the Supermicro Ansible Toolkit.
Please modify the parameters below to suit your environment and requirements.
Refer to the documentation for detailed explanations of each parameter.
_scratch_space: This section is reserved for temporary notes or scratch space.
You can use it to jot down ideas or reminders while configuring the toolkit.
_network_interface_comment: - Set to 'auto' for automatic detection of best available interface
- Leave empty or null to use auto-detection
_interface_priority_comment: First available interface from this list will be used when network_interface is set to 'auto'
